integrity: Complete mathematical proof and two independently organized finite-check programs are supplied. Finite checks are corroborative and do not certify all sizes.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple irreflexive symmetric frames with one named colour per vertex; source a cycle, target connected. No claim for loops, oriented frames, or larger source degree. Potential priority overlap with specialized work on labelled locally-surjective graph homomorphisms.
title: Parity law for colour-preserving modal quotients of finite cycles
